test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All pictures are drawings.

2. No drawing is caricature.

3. All figures are caricatures.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some figures are pictures.

II. No caricature is picture.

III. No picture is figure.

IV. Some caricatures are pictures.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and IV follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram for the given statements is:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c95592adb9d452958450724c0238ac435aef2bdb4a8b12fa9283b25aa0f5e6f.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some figures are pictures → **Doesn't follow** (As it is given in the statement that all pictures are drawings and no drawing is caricature.)

II. No caricature is picture →** ****Follows **(As all pictures are drawings and no drawing is caricatures.)

III. No picture is figure → **Follows **(All pictures are drawings and all figures are caricatures.)

IV. Some caricatures are pictures → **Doesn't follow **(As all pictures are drawings and no drawing is caricature.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II and III follow".**
